# Observation-residual diagnostic: tables (descriptive; no thresholds, no gate, no acceptance)

Units: px unless stated. Patch = centre (x,y). g = 0..4 is stored STAR frame g+1. Definitions are frozen in `PLAN.md`: y stored observation; H = unchanged truth(centre,g) - runtime G[g]; TrH = H + 0.5*H[:,1]; e_Tr = y - TrH; s = y - y[:,0]; eta = s - H. RMS is the root mean square of the vector norm; signed means are per component. `eta` at g=0 is identically 0 by construction; `e_Tr` at g=0 is the observed reference offset/nuisance, not evidence about frame-0 noise. STAR observations carry 5-decimal rounding (5e-6 px/axis half-unit).
